channels.runnerUpDetail: Connected to: {{channels}}. Link codes will be read.
channels.runnerUpNone: It is running, but no channel is configured: set a bot’s credentials in the server environment.
channels.runnerDownDetail: Start “cogenta channels” on the server: until it runs, nobody reads a link code and no message is received.
channels.codeBodyNamed: Send this code in a private message to {{botName}} on {{channel}} to finish linking your account.
channels.unlinkBody: You will no longer receive the site’s notices on this channel or chat with an agent there. You can link it again with a new code.
